Coram : B.N. SRIKRISHNA*, C.K. THAKKER
B Limitation Act, 1963: Article 54-Suit for specific performance-Plaintiff entered into an agreement with defendant for sale of suit property on l 0. 3. I 989-The original C agreement dated 10.3.1989 had a ''fixed date" for performance-However, defendant made a request vide letter dated performance- In 1992, plaintiff was put in possession of the suit property-However, during the night of 31.8.1995 possession of the suit property was forcibly taken over D by the defendant-Trial court decreed the plaintiff's suit for specific performance holding that the suit filed on I 5.9.
Decision Date : 21-10-2005 | Case No : CIVIL APPEAL No. 6202/2004 | Disposal Nature : Appeal(s) allowed | Bench : 2 Judges
